sources.role: Qt/wx native configuration, SDL input, saves, states and optional BIOS

paths.naming: Source QSettings/wxFileConfig INI; explicit --config/-c path overrides the default
Joypad/1..4/<Up|Down|Left|Right|A|B|L|R|Select|Start> values use JoyN-ButtonM, JoyN-AxisM+/-, JoyN-HatMH or the source keyboard grammar; JoyN is an SDL runtime slot

paths.path: ROM-adjacent or user-selected native save path
paths.naming: VBA-M native battery saves use .sav and legacy supplementary .sgm data where present; preserve the existing content basename and path
State filename/path is selected by the frontend; preserve all existing state files
gba_bios.bin, gb_bios.bin and gbc_bios.bin are recognized project firmware names; no checksum is asserted
Controller and keyboard bindings remain in the frontend INI
